title: Slow-Worm
summary: SLOW-WORM, SLOE-WORM, noun An insect found on the leaves of the sloe-tree, which often changes its skin and assumes different colors. It changes into a four winged fly. SLOW-WORM, noun A kind of viper

inlines.v: SLOW-WORM, SLOE-WORM, noun An insect found on the leaves of the sloe-tree, which often changes its skin and assumes different colors. It changes into a four winged fly. SLOW-WORM, noun A kind of viper, the blind worm, scarcely venomous.
